title: Swarm-Built Space Station
claim: Seeded autonomous schedules can grow a multi-dimensional station from content-addressed frames while preserving conflicts, ownership, and disconnected provenance.
invariants: Each agent may append only to its owned dimension and every accepted frame is linked by canonical Web Crypto SHA-256.
Contradictory airlock pressure rules remain as parallel alternatives and reduce exact merge fidelity to five sixths.
A disconnected navigation frame reattaches at the first contradiction-free base in a fixed newest-to-oldest ladder with provenance intact.
Rejected cross-dimension writes and silent conflict overwrites leave all previously verified frame hashes unchanged.
positive_path: Run the seeded schedule to append and merge six dimensions, preserving two airlock alternatives.
Take navigation offline, append stranded work, and deterministically reattach it through the contradiction ladder.
failure_path: Attempt an unauthorized cross-dimension write or silently overwrite one airlock alternative; independent assertions reject both mutations without disturbing verified work.
